messages:
Maya K.: heads up: multiple staging deploys are failing since 03:20 UTC with 401/403 from the api.
Maya K.: error we see in CI logs: `HTTP 401: invalid_token - token_expired` from /v1/deploy endpoint.
ci-deploy-bot: deploy job 2891 failed: unauthorized (token invalid).
Samir (SRE): can you paste the exact curl payload and token used?
Maya K.: here's the failing step: ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_SERVICE_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/deploy -d '{"env":"staging","image":"web:sha-abc"}'
```
Maya K.: token looks like our CI SA token created 2024-11-02; TTL shown as 7d in vault. Last rotated 2025-03-08.
Samir (SRE): vault shows TTL expired for that service account key at 03:18 UTC. CI didn't auto-refresh.
Alex R.: is this the long-lived CI token we've used for historical pipelines? we were planning to move to OIDC.
Maya K.: yes, it's the legacy long-lived service-account token. Seems TTL enforcement kicked in after the tenant policy change.
ops-bot: incident tag created: #inc-2027-089 - staging-deploys-auth-fail
Samir (SRE): quick repro steps: (1) use existing pipeline config pointing to secrets/ci/sa/token (2) trigger a build (3) observe `invalid_token` at deploy POST.
Samir (SRE): logs: ```json
{"ts":"2027-06-12T03:20:05Z","component":"deploy-proxy","status":401,"msg":"token expired","token_id":"sa-ci-42"}
```
Maya K.: impact: all staging deploys queuing, no downstream prod impact yet. Need either emergency bypass or migrate CI to ephemeral/OIDC.
Alex R.: recommended: short term - rotate ci service token and update pipeline, long term - switch CI to OIDC with no static tokens and use least-privilege roles.
Maya K.: can we do emergency rotate? who owns creation rights in vault?
Samir (SRE): I can rotate and update the pipeline var now. But we should scope the token to `deploy:write` only and set TTL to 14d as temporary.
Alex R.: +1. Also add a note to the security tracker to avoid reusing org-wide SA tokens.
Maya K.: performing rotate now: `vault kv put secret/ci/sa token=$(generate-token --scopes deploy:write --ttl 1209600)`
ci-deploy-bot: deploy job 2892 started.
Maya K.: updated pipeline env var and retriggered.
ci-deploy-bot: deploy job 2892 succeeded :tada:
Samir (SRE): temporary mitigation in place. Action items: 1) Migrate CI to OIDC (Samir, due 6/30) 2) Create a migration playbook + runbook for token TTLs (Maya, due 6/20) 3) Audit all CI tokens for least-privilege (Alex, due 6/18) 4) Add alert when CI token TTL < 12h (Samir, due 6/14).
Alex R.: also add a KB entry: `support/ci-service-account-guidance` with recommended scopes and rotation cadence.
Maya K.: filing an internal ticket with details and commands used.
Samir (SRE): follow-up: I implemented an alert rule on vault kv path and a quick ACL to prevent creating org-wide read tokens.
Maya K.: thanks. leaving this thread open until OIDC switch tracked.
Alex R.: noted. good catch by CI alerting. :shipit:
